description:
Schloss Thalheim was built in the Baroque style in the 17th century in a gentle valley, which gave it its name ("Thal", valley), according to the castle's own history page, the main source for this chronology. A domestic wing was added in the 18th century, and a residential wing at the end of the 19th century completed today's U-shaped plan around the old castle. The coat of arms of the Khevenhüller family above the main entrance records a link with that noble family.

The castle chapel was designed in the High Baroque style by Jakob Prandtauer, the architect of Melk Abbey, who married at Schloss Thalheim on 21 July 1692.

A modern restoration has turned the old castle, its wings, the riding hall and the stables into a hotel. The former riding hall is now a large festival hall, the historic stables house the castle's restaurant, Am Schlossgarten, and the hotel has a spa. The Baroque garden, terraced slopes and rose garden have been restored to the original design.
history: Schloss Thalheim was built in the 17th century as a Baroque castle in a small valley in Lower Austria, between St. Pölten and the Danube. A domestic wing was added in the 18th century and a residential wing at the end of the 19th century, giving the estate its U-shaped plan. The architect Jakob Prandtauer, later famous for Melk Abbey, designed its High Baroque chapel and married at the castle in 1692. A modern restoration has turned the old castle, its wings, the riding hall and the stables into a hotel with a restaurant, a spa, a festival hall and restored gardens.

faqs.answer: Jakob Prandtauer, the architect of Melk Abbey, designed the castle's High Baroque chapel and married at Schloss Thalheim on 21 July 1692.

meta_title: Thalheim Castle, Lower Austria — Baroque Castle Hotel with Spa
meta_description: Stay at Thalheim Castle near St. Pölten, Lower Austria — a Baroque castle hotel with a spa, a restaurant and restored gardens. From approx. €253/night.

hotel.room_location_note: Rooms are in the castle estate's historic buildings; ask the hotel which wing your room is in
hotel.how_to_stay:
**Getting there:** The castle stands at Thalheim 22 in the municipality of Kapelln, in the St. Pölten District of Lower Austria, about 13 km east of St. Pölten. Booking lists free private parking with electric charging and accessible parking.

**Rooms & rates:** From approx. €253/night for a 25 m² Standard Double Room with a queen bed, a garden view, air conditioning, soundproofing, a minibar and free Wi-Fi, on a non-refundable rate that can be rescheduled and includes a parking space and early check-in and late check-out; breakfast was about €23 extra, and a free-cancellation rate was around €255 a night. Booking required a minimum stay of two nights on the dates checked and showed a member price that is not included here; taxes and fees were included.

**On-site:** A restaurant in the former stables, a spa with a sauna, massages and a fitness area, a Baroque chapel, restored gardens, free parking and free Wi-Fi; pets are welcome, with possible fees, and Booking lists the property as wheelchair accessible.

**Good to know:** Rates were seen for one January 2027 stay, a low-season date, so check your own dates on Booking. Booking gives the address as Sankt Pölten, but the castle is in the village of Thalheim in the municipality of Kapelln.

**Combine with:** [Dürnstein Castle](/castles/austria/durnstein-castle), the medieval ruin above the Danube in the Wachau, about 27 km to the north-west.
